heroSummary: McKinney ISD's 2026–27 school year begins Thursday, August 13, 2026, and ends Thursday, May 27, 2027. Spring Break is March 15–19, 2027.
calendarNotes: McKinney ISD has 172 instructional days in 2026–27. Students begin August 13, 2026, and finish May 27, 2027. In addition to the major breaks, the calendar includes staff development/student holidays and two reserved bad-weather days on April 5 and April 19.

calendarFaqs.q: When does McKinney ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Thursday, August 13, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is McKinney ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for McKinney ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The final instructional day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Graduation day is listed for Friday, May 28.

calendarFaqs.q: Are McKinney ISD teacher workdays school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: No. McKinney ISD marks staff development and teacher workdays as student holidays on the 2026–27 district calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When do McKinney ISD students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a staff development/student holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens on McKinney ISD's April bad-weather days?
calendarFaqs.a: April 5 and April 19 are reserved bad-weather days. They should not be treated as ordinary guaranteed holidays; check McKinney ISD announcements to confirm whether either date will be used.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar include McKinney ISD campus-specific events?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page covers the districtwide academic calendar. Testing, athletics, performances, registration deadlines, and other campus events should be confirmed with the school.

rows: Students are off August 4–7 and August 10–12 for staff development before classes begin August 13.
Fall Break is only two days, October 12–13. McKinney ISD scheduled a five-day Fall Break in 2025–26.
Winter Break ends January 1, but students return Tuesday, January 5 because January 4 is a staff development/student holiday.
Students are off Monday and Tuesday, February 15–16, for staff development.
The March 15–19 Spring Break is followed one week later by a separate student holiday on March 26.
April 5 and April 19 are reserved bad-weather days; April 16 is a teacher exchange day/student holiday.
The final instructional day is May 27, and graduation day is May 28.

customSections.label: McKinney ISD 2025–26 vs. 2026–27
customSections.content: The largest change is Fall Break: it shrinks from five weekdays in 2025–26 to two weekdays in 2026–27. School starts one day later and ends six calendar days later.

sourceReviewSummary: We checked the listed dates against McKinney ISD's accessible 2026–27 calendar and official PDF. The district shows two separate staff development/student holiday blocks before school starts—August 4–7 and August 10–12—not one continuous August 4–12 closure.
sourceReviewDetails: We compared the student-facing dates and multi-day ranges with the district's accessible calendar and official PDF.
McKinney ISD remains the source of record for revisions, campus events, and emergency closures.
